purpose: Continuation of arm A with paper-consistent validation: val also computes the training objective (2 diffusion steps, focal + L1) and the checkpoint monitor becomes val/paper_loss instead of the single-step plain-L1 proxy

validation.objective: paper-v1: forward_train branch, frozen dropout, seed=epoch*100003+batch_idx
validation.extra_cost: one additional 2-step diffusion forward per validation batch

test.usage: not loaded during training, checkpoint selection or tuning

monitor_rationale.legacy: val/loss used 12 * plain L1 for the trajectory term (forward_test has no loss keys); measured at 1/4.5 of the real objective, so selection was dominated by agent + BEV
monitor_rationale.note: ADE/FDE stay computed from forward_test and are unchanged diagnostics

acceptance.role: paper-consistent monitoring; loss curve should track training objective rather than plateau
stop_or_investigate_if: val/paper_loss rises for two consecutive epochs
val/paper_agent_box_loss or val/paper_agent_class_loss exceeds 1.5x its best-so-far value

guardrails: official V1 model, loss, trajectory targets and official scheduler source unchanged
validation objective matches the training objective; training math and gradients untouched
dropout frozen and sampling seed fixed so the monitor is comparable across epochs
full validation every epoch; val/paper_loss is the only checkpoint monitor
Test split is frozen and never loaded during training or tuning
